dogecoin.text: Additionally, Nasdaq submitted a Form 19b-4 on April 28, 2025, seeking SEC approval to list and trade shares of the 21Shares Dogecoin ETF .

21Shares filed its Form S-1 registration statement for the proposed U.S. spot Dogecoin ETF on April 9, 2025. This filing is currently under review by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) .

BREAKING‼️ 21Shares filed for the first US spot Dogecoin ETF on April 9, '25. This aims to offer direct DOGE exposure via Nasdaq, with Coinbase Custody. Under SEC review, it could significantly boost altcoin acceptance. A Dogecoin ETP launched in Switzerland the same day! https://t.co/qhYLsIKDIw
